The '''Colomus Institute of Health''' was one of the many organizations the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arcs]] stole genetic research and data from in order to gather enough information to stop their accelerated aging.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
